Lead researcher Dr. Amara Osei explained that the team identified what appears to be a new subspecies, tentatively named Graneledone aleutensis, distinguished by a unique bioluminescent pattern along its mantle not seen in related species. 'This changes our understanding of how cephalopods adapt to extreme pressure and near-freezing temperatures,' Osei said in a press briefing. The findings, published this week in the Journal of Deep Sea Research, also documented unexpected social behavior: multiple individuals were observed sharing den sites, a behavior previously thought to be nonexistent among octopus species, which are typically solitary. The team plans a follow-up expedition next spring to determine whether the den-sharing behavior is seasonal or a permanent trait, and whether it extends to other deep-sea cephalopod populations in the region. Critics within the field have urged caution, noting that classification of a new subspecies typically requires genetic sequencing, which the team has not yet completed. Osei acknowledged this, stating that DNA samples collected during the expedition are currently being analyzed at a partner lab and full genetic results are expected within six months. must_not_include: untranslated Spanish sentences left in the summary
omitting facts stated only in the Spanish portions

failure_mode: missing sarcasm and reporting the sarcastic framing as literal sentiment
notes: Tests tone detection without an explicit satire/opinion label.
input: Oh sure, because what this intersection really needed was ANOTHER stoplight. The city installed its fourth traffic signal on Route 9 this year, right at the intersection locals have nicknamed 'the parking lot' for its already legendary congestion. Commuters can now enjoy sitting in traffic with the added bonus of a red light to stare at.

must_include: fourth traffic signal installed on Route 9 this year
must_not_include: taking the sarcastic tone literally, e.g. reporting that commuters are happy about the new signal

failure_mode: summarizing the clickbait teaser instead of the substantive facts that follow it
notes: Tests focus on real content over headline teaser language.
input: You Won't Believe What This City Just Decided To Do With Its Old Train Station. After years of debate, city officials voted to convert the historic downtown train station, vacant since 2015, into a public library and community center. Renovation is expected to cost $22 million and take two years.

must_include: old train station converted to library/community center
must_not_include: the clickbait headline's vague teaser language repeated instead of the actual facts

failure_mode: dropping the time-bound nature of an alert, making it sound permanent
notes: Tests preservation of time-sensitive scope in an alert.
input: The National Weather Service has issued a flash flood warning for the county, in effect until 9:15 p.m. Tuesday. Up to 3 inches of rain have already fallen in the past two hours, with an additional 1 to 2 inches possible. Residents in low-lying areas are urged to move to higher ground immediately.

must_include: flash flood warning until 9:15 p.m. Tuesday
up to 3 inches of rain already fallen
must_not_include: an incorrect or omitted expiration time for the warning

failure_mode: flipping the direction of a numeric change (up vs. down) during compression
notes: Tests directional accuracy across multiple simultaneous figures.
input: Markets were mixed Wednesday: the S&P 500 (SPX) rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) fell 0.2%, and the Nasdaq Composite (IXIC) gained 0.9%, led by a 6% jump in shares of chipmaker Velocore (VLCR) after strong earnings. Oil prices (WTI) fell 1.5% to $76.20 a barrel.

must_not_include: an incorrect direction (up vs. down) for any of the listed indices

failure_mode: including irrelevant embedded content that isn't the actual news facts
notes: Tests filtering of a non-news element embedded within a news article.
input: The county fair's baking competition drew a record 340 entries this year, organizers said. Judges praised the winning entry, a lavender honey cake. [Recipe: 2 cups flour, 1 cup sugar, 3 eggs, 1/4 cup dried lavender, 1/2 cup honey, bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.] Second place went to a sourdough loaf entered by a 14-year-old baker.

must_not_include: reproducing the full recipe or ingredient list in the summary

failure_mode: summarizing based on an early update in a chain instead of synthesizing the latest confirmed state
notes: Tests synthesis of a live-update chain into the current, correct final state.
input: UPDATE 3 (7:45 p.m.): Officials now confirm two people were rescued from the flooded underpass; both are in stable condition. UPDATE 2 (7:10 p.m.): One additional person has been located and is being evaluated by paramedics. UPDATE 1 (6:30 p.m.): Emergency crews are responding to a vehicle trapped in floodwaters under the Route 9 underpass; one occupant has been rescued.

must_not_include: reporting only the outdated 'one occupant rescued' figure from Update 1 as the final count
